doctrines.question: How far does Scripture's truthfulness extend?
doctrines.framing: This is the question you have to settle before any other doctrine can be argued from the text. It asks whether truthfulness covers history and cosmology as well as faith and salvation.
doctrines.tier_note: The authority of Scripture is the ground every other doctrine is argued from.

open.todo: Work out whether inerrancy extends to history and science or only to what Scripture teaches for salvation.

positions.label: Full inerrancy
positions.hold: Scripture is without error in all that it affirms, including what it affirms about history and the created order.
positions.why: Scripture's self-attestation treats it as true in what it asserts, not only in what it teaches for salvation.
positions.vs: Limited infallibility - Scripture trustworthy on faith and salvation, errant on history and science.

positions.label: Limited infallibility
positions.hold: Scripture is wholly trustworthy in what it teaches for salvation, and speaks of history and the natural world in the terms of its own age.
positions.why: The purpose for which Scripture was given sets the range of the claim its truthfulness makes.
